params.description: Multi-timeframe mean-reversion for strong downtrend: Enters on 5-min RSI(2) < 10 AND price below BB lower band (20,2). Confirms with 50-period EMA slope downtrend. Exits when price crosses above 20-period EMA. Hard stop at 1.5x ATR(14). Time stop at 30 bars. ADX > 25 confirms trend strength.

Multi-timeframe mean reversion in strong downtrend. Uses 200-period SMA on higher timeframe to confirm bearish regime, then 20/50 SMA crossover on lower timeframe for entry timing with RSI < 30 oversold filter. ADX > 25 ensures trend strength.
